newsitem.title: USA: Third letter bomb destined for Kansas prison found.
newsitem.headline: Third letter bomb destined for Kansas prison found.

text.p: Police said they found a third letter bomb destined for Leavenworth Prison on Friday at the local post office, and turned it over to the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

Two letter bombs addressed to the parole officer at the federal prison were discovered on Thursday, when five similar devices were found in Washington, D.C., including one intercepted at the main post office addressed to a Saudi Arabian newspaper office. None of the bombs have exploded.
The two letter bombs discovered Thursday at Leavenworth prison have been shipped to the FBI's laboratory in Washington, an FBI spokeswoman said.
The spokesman said the FBI had asked its legal attache in Egypt to help investigate the bombs, which were apparently sent from the Egyptian city of Alexandria.
Four of the devices were found at the Washington offices of the Saudi-owned newspaper Al-Hayat and a fifth addressed to the paper was intercepted at the post office.
